subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on July 15, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XYZ123, Departure: 10:00 AM, Arrival: 1:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Flight Booking Team
